lines.text: Can an old banner become a bag people buy?
lines.phonemes: kæn ɐn ˈoʊld bˈænɚ bɪkˌʌm ɐ bˈæɡ pˈiːpəl bˈaɪ?

lines.text: Bags cut from used truck tarps have sold in Zurich since 1993.
lines.tts: Bags cut from used truck tarps have sold in Zurich since nineteen ninety-three.
lines.phonemes: bˈæɡz kˈʌt fɹʌm jˈuːzd tɹˈʌk tˈɑːɹps hæv sˈoʊld ɪn zjˈʊɹɪk sˈɪns nˈaɪntiːn nˈaɪntiθɹˈiː.

lines.text: Cut away faded or torn parts, then cut and stitch the panels.
lines.phonemes: kˈʌt ɐwˈeɪ fˈeɪdᵻd ɔːɹ tˈɔːɹn pˈɑːɹts, ðˈɛn kˈʌt ænd stˈɪtʃ ðə pˈænəlz.

lines.text: Assume twenty totes; banner, labour and handles cost ₹1,700.
lines.tts: Assume twenty totes; banner, labor and handles cost seventeen hundred rupees.
lines.phonemes: ɐsˈuːm twˈɛnti tˈoʊts; bˈænɚ, lˈeɪbɚɹ ænd hˈændəlz kˈɔst sˈɛvəntˌiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz.

lines.text: If sixteen sell for ₹150 each, about ₹700 is left.
lines.tts: If sixteen sell for a hundred and fifty each, about seven hundred is left.
lines.phonemes: ɪf sˈɪkstiːn sˈɛl fɚɹə hˈʌndɹɪd ænd fˈɪfti ˈiːtʃ, ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: The banner is cheap; labour and unsold bags decide the margin.
lines.tts: The banner is cheap; labor and unsold bags decide the margin.
lines.phonemes: ðə bˈænɚɹ ɪz tʃˈiːp; lˈeɪbɚɹ ænd ʌnsˈoʊld bˈæɡz dᵻsˈaɪd ðə mˈɑːɹdʒɪn.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
